value.note: verbatim: ““ Commitment ”: as to any Lender, the obligation of such Lender, if any, to make Loans and participate in Letters of Credit in an aggregate principal and/or face amount not to exceed the amount set forth under the heading “Commitment” opposite such Lender’s name on Schedule 1.1A or in the Assignment and Assumption pursuant to which such Lender became a party hereto, as the same may be changed from time to time pursuant to the terms hereof. As of the Closing Date, the amount of the Total Commitments is $1,000,000,000.”

value.value: Term Benchmark Loans: Adjusted Term SOFR plus Applicable Margin; ABR Loans: ABR plus Applicable Margin; RFR Loans: Adjusted Daily Simple SOFR plus Applicable Margin. Applicable Margin for Term Benchmark/RFR Loans ranges 1.125% to 1.75%; for ABR Loans 0.125% to 0.75% (per leverage/ratings grid). Adjusted Term SOFR = Term SOFR Rate plus 0.10%; Floor = zero. Default interest = otherwise applicable rate plus 2%.
value.note: verbatim: “(a) (i) Each Term Benchmark Loan shall bear interest for each day during each Interest Period with respect thereto at a rate per annum equal to the Adjusted Term SOFR determined for such day plus the Applicable Margin and (ii) each RFR Loan (solely to the extent applicable following the implementation of a Benchmark Replacement pursuant to Section 2.10 ) shall bear interest at a rate per annum equal to the Adjusted Daily Simple SOFR plus the Applicable Margin. (b) Each ABR Loan shall bear interest at a rate per annum equal to the ABR plus the Applicable Margin.”

value.value: Termination Date: the fifth anniversary of the Closing Date (Closing Date = March 26, 2024), subject to extension pursuant to Section 2.18 (up to two one-year extensions). Borrower shall repay all outstanding Loans on the Termination Date.
value.note: verbatim: ““ Termination Date ”: the fifth anniversary of the Closing Date, subject to the extension thereof pursuant to Section 2.18 .”

value.value: Consolidated Leverage Ratio not to exceed 4.00 to 1.00 (or 4.50 to 1.00 during an Acquisition Step-Up Period), tested at end of each fiscal quarter for the trailing four consecutive fiscal quarters on a Pro Forma Basis.
value.note: verbatim: “7.1 Financial Condition Covenant . Permit the Consolidated Leverage Ratio, calculated as at the end of any fiscal quarter for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters of the Borrower then ended, on a Pro Forma Basis, to exceed (x) 4.00 to 1.00, or (y) 4.50 to 1.00 for any fiscal quarter during any Acquisition Step-Up Period, calculated as at the end of any fiscal quarter ending during any Acquisition Step-Up Period; provided that that there shall be no more than two Acquisition Step-Up Periods after the Closing Date and each Acquisition Step-Up Period shall be separated by at least two calendar quarters.”

value.value: Facility is unsecured at closing (no grant of collateral). Springing guarantee: each Domestic Subsidiary that guarantees Borrower Indebtedness of $150,000,000 or more must guarantee the Obligations within 60 days (Section 6.7). Equal-and-ratable security clause: under Section 7.3, if the Borrower/Subsidiary creates a Lien to secure Indebtedness (other than Permitted Liens), the Obligations must be secured equally and ratably.
value.note: verbatim: “6.7 Subsidiary Guarantee . (a) Each Domestic Subsidiary that guarantees Indebtedness of the Borrower of the type contemplated by clauses (a) and (c) of the definition thereof in an aggregate principal amount of $150,000,000 or more will guarantee the Obligations under the Facility pursuant to documentation reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent within 60 days of the incurrence of such guarantee (or such longer period as may be agreed by the Administrative Agent).”

value.value: Events of Default (Section 8.1): (a) payment default (principal when due; interest/other amounts within 5 days); (b) misrepresentation; (c) breach of specified covenants (Section 6.4(a)(i)/(ii), 6.6(a), Section 7); (d) other covenant default unremedied 30 days after notice; (e) cross-default/cross-acceleration on Indebtedness exceeding $200,000,000; (f) bankruptcy/insolvency (60-day period for involuntary); (g) ERISA events with Material Adverse Effect; (h) judgments of $200,000,000 or more unvacated within 60 days; (i) change of control (>50% of outstanding common stock). business_description.value: Gartner, Inc. provides business and technology insights for decisions and performance on an organization’s mission-critical priorities in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Insights, Conferences, and Consulting. The Research segment delivers insights through subscription services, such as access to published content, data and benchmarks, and direct access to a network of business and technology experts. The Conferences segment offers executives and teams in an organization the opportunity to learn, share, and network through its Symposium/Xpo series and peer-driven sessions, as well as conferences focused on specific business roles and topics. The Consulting segment provides technology-driven strategic initiatives, including custom analysis and on-the-ground support to senior executives. This segment also offers actionable solutions for IT-related priorities, including IT cost optimization, digital transformation, and IT sourcing optimization. Gartner, Inc. was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut.
